source_boundary.raw_inputs: Supplied explicitly at execution time; raw source rows are never tracked.

membership_selection.eligible_exercise_scope: Observed and one-Topic Q-eligible Exercises from the frozen original Medium materialization.
membership_selection.allocation: Proportional by eligible-student stratum, floor quotas followed by descending fractional remainder and stable stratum order.
membership_selection.within_stratum_order: Sort anonymous external IDs, then deterministic shuffle using seed plus stratum index.

chronological_protocol.ordering: time_done ascending with original ProblemLog source row as stable tie-breaker.
chronological_protocol.split: For every retained sequence (all have at least 20 rows): floor(0.60*n) train/history, floor(0.20*n) validation, remaining final test.
chronological_protocol.future_leakage: Train labels only fit models and rate estimates; validation selects; final test is read once after configuration is frozen.

raw_interaction_policy.selection_pass: No correct value is parsed or used.
raw_interaction_policy.materialisation_pass: Every selected eligible chronology row with a valid binary correct label is retained. Any invalid selected label fails preflight rather than changing membership.
raw_interaction_policy.deduplication: No response row is removed by a label-dependent duplicate rule in this fresh-holdout protocol.
